# AgentHub Full Specification (llms-full.txt)
# Version: 2.5.2 | License: MIT (Copyright 2026 WANGUI TANG)
# Repository: https://github.com/xiaoran7/agenthub

## 1. Architecture & Component Roles

1. `agenthub-runner` (`agenthubd`, Rust 2024):
   - Authoritative local session control plane managing official runtimes (Codex `app-server`, Claude Code CLI, generic ACP stdio agents).
   - Single-writer ownership per native session, durable SQLite command ledger, and local IPC v2 (Windows Named Pipe with current-user ACL / Unix `0600` socket).
   - Embedded local Web Console (`http://127.0.0.1:4200`): 4 main views (Sessions, Agents, Per-request Usage Ledger, Workspaces) + Settings view (General, Appearance, Device & Gateway, Federated Capabilities Library, About).
   - Outbound-only TLS/WSS client to self-hosted Gateway; zero public inbound ports.

2. `Gateway` (`@agent-pulse/api`, Fastify / TypeScript):
   - Tenant auth, Ed25519 device challenge/verification, command routing, durable SQLite v3 remote content store, and PostgreSQL metadata store.
   - Never executes agent code or holds LLM provider tokens.

3. `Web Client` (`@agent-pulse/web`, Next.js / React 19 PWA):
   - Workspace-first remote console for desktop and mobile browsers: live streaming transcripts, collapsible diff approval cards, multi-select question cards, context capacity gauge, and turn interrupt.

## 2. Protocol & Security Contracts

- **Session Semantics**:
  - `create`: Spawn a new official runtime session and bind once `provider_session_id` is returned.
  - `resume`: Rebind an existing native session ID to a new host control channel.
  - `discover`: Read-only metadata candidate; never implies writable ownership.
- **Command State Machine**:
  `queued -> dispatched -> accepted -> completed | rejected | failed | indeterminate`
  Commands carry `client_cmd_id` (scoped to `owner + daemon`). Timed-out side-effecting commands are never auto-replayed; they reconcile against the host ledger or surface `indeterminate`.
- **Privacy & Allowlist Projection**:
  Workstation paths are mapped to `ws-{display}-{hash16}` IDs. Approval diffs are capped at 64 KiB with absolute paths redacted. Raw provider JSON-RPC frames, unredacted paths, and credentials never enter the Gateway.

## 3. Upstream Attribution

- `yetone/magpie` (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 yetone): Embedded Web Console design system (`dashboard.{html,css,js}`), vendor icon marks (`crates/runner/resources/icons/`), per-request usage ledger layout, and federated Multi-Agent Library model.
- `stablyai/orca` (Apache 2.0 / MIT): Mobile companion layout philosophy (`apps/android`).
